title: The Palace Voice — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of The Palace Voice's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. No challenger read it. Every section is a proposal until Loudon approves it.

pieces.title: The dial that drifted
pieces.caption: Em-dashes and bold per thousand words of entry prose, month by month. Em-dashes climb from 14 to 20 by July, hold through September, and have eased to 17. Bold falls the whole way, from 24.5 to 15.4. *What is real and what is a choice:* Counted with the page's own linter on the palace's entries at each month's last commit. The page's 41 and 53 percent compare entries by birth month, a different question, and a challenger's rerun of that gave about 18 and 20. August is marked because the dial was named then; the chart does not show the gate causing anything.

verdicts.file: The Palace Voice — rich — the dial that drifted.svg
verdicts.why: The series is reproduced, but the chart answers a different question from the page and then leans on it: it pools every tracked .md, and the fall "to 15 once the gate was in" is mostly dilution. All-.md words went from 0.99M in August to 2.34M in November while canon-entry prose stayed near 450K;

remade.file: The Palace Voice — rich — the dial that drifted.svg
remade.what: The first chart pooled every .md file, so the palace doubling in size looked like the voice recovering. Recounted the linter's way; the axis now starts at zero; the fall is no longer credited to the August gate.
